projects_main_text: Some of my personal and open-source projects will be published here, on my LinkedIn page, and on my GitHub.
landpage_project_description: A sample landing page for your store or business with great responsiveness. Get in touch to have yours built! The project uses TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind.
marvel_project_description: An online comic book store REST API built with React and Styled Components, allowing you to browse your favorite comics and add them to your shopping cart.
feelsocial_project_description: A social network project built with TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind, featuring a beautiful design and functionalities such as chat and user login.
galery_project_description: An animal image gallery project built with React.
marketlist_project_description: A fully customizable and fast shopping list app, designed to be simple to use without overwhelming options, perfect for everyday grocery shopping.
flappybird_project_description: A Flappy Bird-style game created using JavaScript during the WEB MODERNO course by Cod3r.
